---
name: Feature Request / RFC
about: Suggest an idea, theoretical innovation, or architectural enhancement for Gen-Zero
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'discussion']
assignees: ''
---

## Summary / Proposal
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature, mathematical formulation, or systems enhancement.

## Motivation & Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Is there a specific bottleneck (e.g. latency, memory footprint, search depth, safety guarantee) or an emerging theoretical advance (e.g. Symplectic geometry, Manifold GFlowNet)?

## Proposed Technical Solution
Describe your proposed solution in detail:
- Affected crate(s) (e.g., `gen-zero-planner`, `gen-zero-lod`, `gen-zero-service`).
- Proposed API / Trait signatures.
- Mathematical formalisms or invariant guarantees (if applicable).
- Memory / latency impact and zero-allocation considerations.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, trade-offs, or features you've considered.

## Backward Compatibility & SLA Impact
Does this change break existing MCP schemas, serialized MMR formats, or affect the sub-millisecond System 1/2 SLAs?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, research papers, or references here.
